flows.title: Add a question to a survey
steps: Click the target at the centre of the blank page, or click the Add New Question link at the bottom of the page.

A question starts as the Radio Buttons type, which lets someone pick one choice from a list. Use the Question Type dropdown to choose the type you want; the preview on the left updates as you try each one, and nothing is committed until you choose.
If you are unsure which type fits, click the Question Types Cheatsheet link to read about them, then click Use this Question Type to take one.
Enter the question you want to ask. The survey on the left updates as you type.
Add the answers people can choose: enter them one at a time with Click to Add Option, or use Paste in options and put each answer on its own line.
